notes.title: Update & Project Explanation!
notes.content:
[h1]Ansel Support![/h1]
We added Nvidia Ansel support to the game. We are very excited to see what kind of screenshots you can come up with. 

Ansel is a revolutionary new way to capture in-game shots and view in 360. Compose your screenshots from any position, adjust them with post-process filters, capture HDR images in high-fidelity formats, and share them in 360 degrees using your mobile phone, PC, or VR headset.
[url=https://www.geforce.com/whats-new/articles/ansel-revolutionizing-game-screenshots]More Information about ANSEL[/url]

[h1]Small Fixes[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Removed framerate cap (Used to be 35fps max)
    [*]Fixed AI bug for the Heavy type (Would sometimes just stand around)
[/list]

[h1]Project Explanation[/h1]
Since it apparently has not been clear enough in the game description: This is a game made by STUDENTS for our university coursework. Almost 40 students have worked on this project for almost a whole school year, and have decided to release it for free. 

Our aim was to simulate working in a AAA Studio, developing several features and mechanics within the given timespan. Since we received a lot of requests to publish the game after finishing the project we decided to do so for free.

We hope you enjoy this as a nice experience rather than an actual game.

notes.title: EINAAARRR!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29619067/9f355f0adf43944473de88bfd87eec779d26dfb8.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

[h1]We're Live![/h1]
We at DreamPunks would like to announce that the game has finally gone live! We are sorry it took a bit longer than promised, but this had to do with the large review qeue Valve had to finish for this awesome platform before it could reach Einar.

[h1]Have Fun![/h1]
We hope you will have an awesome experience playing our game, and are looking forward to reveiving some screenshots, feedback and videos from you guys.

[h1]Updates![/h1]
As some of you might already know, we are currently working on some updates, which will add ANSEL integration (360 screenshots), and Achievements.

[h1]Easter Eggs![/h1]
How many have you found yet? ;)

Best regards,
Einar development team

notes.title: Important Launch Information!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29619067/a033e178e154370285815ef480feeba1fbd79a0a.png[/img]


Hi everyone!

[h1]Massive Interest[/h1]
We at DreamPunks would like to thank everyone for the massive interest you have shown in Einar so far! :) We however also received quite a lot of questions with regards the launch date. 

[h1]Launch Delay[/h1]
The steam page used to show [i]14-07-2017[/i] as the official launch date, which used to be true. However, due to some delays in the Build Review Queue on Valve their side this has been delayed a bit. This is also the reason we have decided to remove the launch date from our page to prevent any further dissapointments.

[h1]New Launch Date[/h1]
This review time usually takes [i]2-3 business days[/i], depending on how busy Valve is.  [b]Hopefully this means everyone should be able to download the game within the next three business days[/b]. Please note that we are not doing this on purpose, and hope Valve will resolve this soon. Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
Einar development team
